name: YT
description: '''Oluwatola Joseph Fola-Alade''' (born May 5, 2001), known professionally as '''YT''', is an English rapper, producer and songwriter from [[Romford]], [[East London]]. He first gained popularity in 2021 with his viral single "Arc'teryx", and later through [[Jerk (music genre)|jerk music]] and becoming a pioneer in the [[UK underground rap]] scene.
